verdict.rationale: There is no documented dedicated sandbox or test environment. A user could stand up a separate self-hosted server (the same software as Zulip Cloud) as an isolated test instance and use export/import tools to copy data into it. The bots docs also imply developing a bot before deploying it to production via the Botserver. This is an indirect workaround rather than a first-class sandbox. Missing for 10: an official sandbox or test-organization offering, documented dev/test API credentials or isolation from production data, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of a testing workflow.
